switches.label: Zone priority
switches.description: Z2: the guardrails' zone_ahead check and the zone aims, all under this switch; off behaves as before Z2 (no zone rule anywhere).

switches.label: Zone-ahead check
switches.description: Z2: no trade into a decisive opposing zone inside max(1R, 0.75 ATR(1H)); trend exempts a with-trend plan, all exempts none (owner-set only, one warning line per decision). record and off are config-only.

switches.label: Typed key-level zones
switches.description: Z0: demand/supply type, strength and freshness on the Key Level Agent's zones; off removes every typed field, and every zone rule then behaves as before.

switches.label: Zone aims
switches.description: Z2b: the execution plans aimed by zone type; the tokens listed are the rules ON (tp: TP2 at the next decisive opposing zone; stop: the stop past a decisive opposing zone; factor: pickStrategy's zone factor). Note: stop on with tp off, the reward gate holds stop_skip back more often (the stop widens, the target stays); ZONE_AIM_TP only matters while tp is on.

switches.label: Zone typing sources
switches.description: Z1a/Z1b: the evidence sources the zone typing reads; the tokens listed are the sources ON (prophet_zone, prophet_best, whale, gabfx, gmi_flag, gmi_ob). Taking gmi_ob off restores Z1a's typing (gmi_flag back on the 15m); taking prophet_zone off too restores Z0's. Not set in the config: every source on.

switches.label: Zone aim: TP1
switches.description: Z2b: label keeps TP1's price (its words only); qualified moves TP1 to a nearer decisive opposing qualified zone at or beyond ZONE_NEED, owner-set only and only after the owner's TP1-KZ amendment (tp1_kz@2). Matters only while the tp aim is on.

switches.label: Zone readings and breaker
switches.description: Z5: the zone readings, the counterfactual tables (zone_blocked_setups, zone_rule_arms) and the decision-side zone breaker, which holds Z2/Z2b's rules back by itself when their own record turns against them; off writes nothing, the breaker is idle and GET /api/zones answers 404.

switches.label: Entry zone
switches.description: EZ1: the band beside the plan's entry where Omega may rest its limit; edge also uses the zone's near edge when the plan's level is out of the placement band, on is EZ1 alone, off sends no zone.

switches.label: TP1 at the nearest key zone
switches.description: TP1-KZ: TP1 at the nearest key zone at least 1R away; off restores the earlier targets and gates.

switches.label: Chart patterns
switches.description: The Projection Agent's chart patterns in its reading and in the strategy; off leaves them out.

switches.label: Grid adaptation
switches.description: The grid's automatic entry and stop per strategy and regime, chosen once a UTC day; off keeps every plan's own entry and stop.

switches.label: Room waiver on a with-trend breakout
switches.description: RM1b: the room check passes when it alone holds a side back, the 15m close is beyond the facing edge of a corridor recorded in the last hour, and the trend is with the side; it goes off by itself for 7 days when its waived trades lose. The owner's choice here wins over that revert; reset hands it back to the revert and the config.

switches.label: Strategy-agent veto rule
switches.description: SV1b: two_sided lets an agent that speaks on both sides no longer count against the side it also speaks for (A6, A7); it goes back to classic by itself for 7 days when its softened trades lose. The owner's choice here wins over that revert; reset hands it back to the revert and the config.

switches.label: Call for Councils
switches.description: suggest runs the hourly suggestion flags (no model call); on also lets the owner open council sessions (with the switch on the Councils page); off runs nothing.

switches.label: Shadow per-mode evidence
switches.description: MS2: each mode not in force is decided deterministically at every 15m decision, for the mode selector's evidence only; off writes no shadow row and the selector reads live setups alone.

switches.label: Mode probation
switches.description: MS2: a switch to a mode with fewer than 31 live setups trades at half the risk on Omega's new orders of that mode until it passes or fails; off: full risk.

switches.label: Liquidity card for the council
switches.description: B15: lens B's LIQUIDITY card beside the witnesses, for the council only (never the quorum, the guardrails or the weights); off: no card and the council's prompt as before.

switches.label: Liquidity conditions in the rooms
switches.description: B16: conditions lets the risk desk and the moderator read lens B's liquidity conditions (plain words, no price); brief keeps the brief's line only. No model call is added either way.

switches.label: Calendar contrarian drift
switches.description: The Calendar Agent: a release kind whose gold drifted against the consensus significantly leans the other way; off holds it at 0.

switches.label: Learned-note shadow arm
switches.description: Aether's learned notes tested in shadow (an extra opening call per agent, capped per hour), never in a live prompt; off stops the arm at once. Shown as on/off; the variable holds true/false.

switches.label: Knowledge verdicts to the platform
switches.description: KA2: the arm's verdicts posted to the platform for Aether's curator; needs the learned-note shadow arm on.

switches.label: Metric rebuttals
switches.description: The metric rebuttal shadow arm: anything but off counts as on, and it also needs METRIC_SHADOW. Retired by the owner on 2026-11-19 (every arm stopped), so shown here for information only.

switches.label: Owner corrections to the platform (H3f)
switches.description: HAIC H3f: the owner's ratings and corrections of Nexus outputs (POST /omega/api/correction) stored here with prices masked and sent to the platform as nexus-teacher; off records and sends nothing. Never changes a parameter, a weight or a gate.

switches.label: Profit-lock gate
switches.description: SLG1: no stop moves into profit until the position's MFE on closed bars of its mode's timeframe reaches the mode's threshold; legacy: the earlier locks.

switches.label: Change thresholds
switches.description: CH1: a confluence or confidence change acts only past its threshold, per trigger (conf, tpw, limit, skip, stance); a trigger left off uses the earlier rule.

switches.label: 1m fast-protect layer
switches.description: PM-1M: the fast TP anticipation and loss reduction on closed broker M1 bars; off: the engine as before.

switches.label: 1m re-entry after a lock stop
switches.description: RE1: one re-entry of a setup a break-even or lock stop closed, when a closed broker 1m bar closes back beyond the lock; off: the engine as before.

switches.label: Newer signal supersedes a resting limit
switches.description: SS1: a newer same-side signal deletes Omega's older resting, unfilled limit, then goes through every gate; off: the engine as before.

switches.label: Confidence-drop gate (CDG)
switches.description: CDG: a confidence drop closes a winner only where the learned gate passes for the agent, side and drop bucket (lift >= 0.10 over n >= 30); every other drop is held. Reverts itself to off once if its first 15 outcomes average worse than the earlier rule; off: the engine as before.

switches.label: Zone-typed management (Z3a)
switches.description: Z3a: omega moves SL+ behind the position's own decisive demand or supply zone (at most 0.15-0.30R looser than today's, never below the lock) and the trailing TP to a decisive opposing zone at most one zone further; one modify per position per 3 minutes across this and the 1m fast layer. off: the engine as before (the documented rollback). The owner's switch only.
